events.title: IEEPA national emergency on U.S. bulk-power system equipment
events.why_it_matters: The order lets DOE prohibit or condition foreign-produced grid equipment (transformers, inverters, BESS, industrial controls) tied to covered foreign entities, with FAR procurement preference for U.S.-made energy infrastructure.
events.what_to_watch: DOE implementing rules due within 120 days, Covered Foreign Entity designations, and any forced rip-and-replace of installed Chinese/embargo-country kit at utilities and data-center interconnects.

events.title: U.S. Section 338 bans and tariff-scope reset vs Canada
events.why_it_matters: After Canada's ~$20bn retaliatory tariffs, Trump signed five Section 338 proclamations banning some Canadian alcohol and dairy and swapping products (ATVs, more dairy in; rock salt/cement out); duties stack on Section 232 and apply even to USMCA-origin goods.
events.what_to_watch: Scope changes effective 2026-09-15, import bans 2026-09-29, threatened 50% auto tariffs from 2027-01-01, and any GSA delisting of Canadian-origin products.

events.title: House clears FY2027 CR through Dec. 11, shutdown risk off
events.why_it_matters: A 370-48 House vote sent a Senate-passed stopgap (90-6 on Aug. 8) to the President, funding agencies through 2026-12-11 at FY2026 levels and removing the Oct. 1 shutdown threat before midterms.
events.what_to_watch: Presidential signature, Dec. 11 cliff, blocked $1bn Trump-class battleship start vs other Navy shipbuilding anomalies, and hemp-ban/OMB-grant riders that Freedom Caucus opposed.

events.title: OFAC sanctions remaining Iranian airlines (Operation Economic Outcast)
events.why_it_matters: Treasury designated 36 targets including 27 Iranian airlines, third-country aircraft intermediaries, and GSAs, and suspended Iran aviation authorizations, widening secondary-sanctions risk around Iran oil/aviation logistics.
events.what_to_watch: SDN fallout for UAE/Turkey/Malaysia facilitators, FinCEN aviation-procurement alert compliance, and any further squeeze on remaining Iran crude export routes.

events.title: EO: Packers & Stockyards enforcement and interstate meat access
events.why_it_matters: USDA must intensify Packers and Stockyards Act probes with DOJ, ease interstate shipment for state-inspected meat, and stand up SPUR loans for small/regional processors—pressure on concentrated packers, support for ranchers.
events.what_to_watch: 60-day USDA enforcement and barrier reports, DOJ referrals, and any MCOOL/wolf-delisting follow-through in the companion ranchers order.

events.title: EO adjusting Defense Production Act energy delegations
events.why_it_matters: Interior and Energy now independently share DPA energy authorities, with energy disputes routed first to the National Energy Dominance Council—faster, potentially conflicting priority ratings for fuels, minerals, and grid buildout.
events.what_to_watch: First Interior vs DOE DPA uses on energy projects and any dual-hatting fights that hit permitting or offtake.

events.title: August employment report: +162k, jobless rate 4.1%
events.why_it_matters: Payrolls crushed ~65k consensus with +55k prior-month revisions, lifting CME FedWatch September hike odds to ~60% and pushing 10-year yields toward 4.8%.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Sept. 11 CPI confirms a hike at the Sept. 16 FOMC; 2-year yield and rate-sensitive growth/tech.

events.title: Broadcom FQ3: AI beat, FY27 AI revenue double talk, Q4 guide a hair light
events.why_it_matters: Revenue $29.59bn vs $29.36bn, adj. EPS $3.32 vs $3.24, AI semis $16.7bn; Q4 rev guided $34.8bn vs ~$35.03bn while Tan sketched $115bn AI revenue in FY27 and residual-value support for labs.
events.what_to_watch: Custom ASIC share vs NVDA, Anthropic/Google TPU GW ramps, and whether financing/guarantee language becomes a sector overhang.

events.title: U.S.–Iran tanker strikes; Hormuz supply shock, oil toward $100
events.why_it_matters: CENTCOM struck Iranian crude carriers after IRGC shots at U.S. ships; Hormuz remains effectively closed, Brent tagged ~$100, diesel at record highs—stagflation input into the FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Iran's threatened new restricted zone, tanker traffic/AIS, SPR draws, and whether CPI energy keeps a September hike on the table.

events.title: China 360bn yuan recap of state banks and insurers
events.why_it_matters: Finance ministry-led ~¥360bn (~$45–50bn) private placements (ABC, ICBC, China Life, PICC, ExIm, etc.) to keep credit flowing as growth slows, with CNY at strongest vs USD since Jan 2023.
events.what_to_watch: Follow-through lending vs property still-weak, Sept. 20 LPR, and any Bessent–He Lifeng deliverables ahead of a late-September Washington visit.

events.title: August CPI (pre-FOMC inflation print)
events.why_it_matters: Last major CPI before the Sept. 16 decision; consensus near 3.4% y/y headline with oil/war upside risk after a hot payrolls print.
events.what_to_watch: Core vs energy; a hot print likely locks a 25bp hike, a cool print reopens a hold (Waller's data-dependent split).

events.title: August PPI
events.why_it_matters: Pipeline inflation print 24 hours before CPI; energy and goods pipeline will set Friday's CPI surprise risk.
events.what_to_watch: Core PPI ex-food/energy and trade-services; a hot PPI into CPI is the cleanest path to a Sept. 16 hike.

events.title: FOMC decision, SEP/dot plot, Warsh press conference
events.why_it_matters: Projections meeting with hike odds already ~60% after 162k payrolls and war-driven oil; first real test of Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole 'more work to do' line.
events.what_to_watch: 25bp vs hold, dots vs 2026–27 median, QT language, and dissent; 2s/10s and rate-sensitive housing/tech.

events.title: Oracle Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Company-confirmed AMC print/call is the next large-cap AI-cloud capex/RPO checkpoint after Broadcom's custom-chip beat.
events.what_to_watch: Cloud infrastructure growth, remaining performance obligations, capex, and any AI-lab concentration commentary.

events.title: ECB Governing Council decision (Berlin)
events.why_it_matters: Policy meeting Sept. 9–10 with a hold at 2.25% deposit widely expected, but energy-war inflation keeps a hawkish lean in play versus the Fed's hike debate.
events.what_to_watch: Statement on energy/Middle East, any hike bias, and EUR/USD vs U.S. CPI/FOMC week.

events.title: BoJ MPM: hike risk to ~1.25%
events.why_it_matters: Ueda has said hikes are on the table every meeting; energy, weak yen, and tight labor raise odds of +25bp from ~1.00%, a USD/JPY event with global duration spillovers.
events.what_to_watch: Policy-rate vote, yen reaction around intervention-sensitive levels, and JGB/global 10-year backup.

events.title: Treasury 9y11m / 29y11m reopenings
events.why_it_matters: About $39bn 10-year-equivalent today and $22bn 30-year-equivalent Thursday settle into 10s near three-year highs (~4.8%) after hot payrolls and oil.
events.what_to_watch: High yield vs when-issued, bid-to-cover, dealer vs international take-down; a tail would tighten financial conditions into CPI/FOMC.

events.title: US-Iran conflict escalation: Iran fires on Jordan base, US hits 5 tankers
events.why_it_matters: Iran fired ballistic missiles at Al-Azraq air base in Jordan and attacked 10 ships while US destroyed 5 Iranian oil tankers — the largest wave of shipping attacks since the war began, with Brent near $99.
events.what_to_watch: Whether oil breaches $100 and whether the conflict draws in more US allies or triggers a broader supply disruption.

events.title: FOMC September decision — first Warsh SEP/dots
events.why_it_matters: Funds rate 3.50-3.75%; blowout NFP (+162k) and Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech have pushed hike odds to ~57%, making this the single biggest market catalyst of the window.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the Fed hikes 25bp or holds, and the tone of the first Warsh SEP/dots.

events.title: US August CPI
events.why_it_matters: July CPI was +3.4% y/y; August will capture the Hormuz oil spike feeding the energy channel directly into the FOMC decision.
events.what_to_watch: Headline vs core CPI and whether energy pass-through exceeds consensus.

events.title: US August PPI
events.why_it_matters: July PPI was +4.7% y/y; pipeline read into CPI and the FOMC decision.
events.what_to_watch: Whether producer prices accelerate further on energy pass-through.

events.title: ECB rate decision (Berlin)
events.why_it_matters: Markets expect ECB to move in the same direction as the Fed — up — for the first time this cycle, with energy-driven inflation pressure in the euro area.
events.what_to_watch: Whether ECB hikes and the guidance on further moves.

events.title: Bank of Japan rate decision
events.why_it_matters: BOJ held at ~1.0% in July warning core inflation likely to accelerate 'clearly above' 2% from 2H FY2026; yen intervention risk remains live.
events.what_to_watch: Whether BOJ hikes again and any yen intervention signals.

events.title: China August CPI/PPI — energy-driven inflation
events.why_it_matters: China's August CPI rose 0.8% y/y and PPI rose 3.8% y/y, lifted by global energy costs — signaling sustained recovery in domestic demand but adding import-cost pressure.
events.what_to_watch: Whether PPI acceleration forces PBoC to reconsider easing pace.

events.title: China August trade data — exports +25% y/y
events.why_it_matters: Exports surged 25% y/y to $401B, imports +28.2%, trade surplus widened to $119B — AI/electronics demand and tariff diversion still offset weak domestic demand.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the widening surplus intensifies US pressure ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.

events.title: US August NFP — +162k blowout
events.why_it_matters: Nonfarm payrolls surged to +162k vs ~53-58k expected, unemployment steady at 4.1% — reshaped Fed hike odds higher and roiled markets.
events.what_to_watch: Whether subsequent data (CPI, retail sales) confirms the strength or shows it was a one-off.

events.title: Canada retaliatory tariffs on $20B US goods take effect
events.why_it_matters: Canada imposed C$27.6B (US$20B) of retaliatory tariffs on US goods starting Sept 8, doubling duties on US steel/aluminum to 50%, as the trade war with Washington intensifies.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the US escalates further (motorcycle/dairy/alcohol bans) and impact on USMCA talks.

events.title: USMCA 4th round review talks (Washington)
events.why_it_matters: US withheld USMCA renewal July 1, leaving pact on annual clock; 4th round in Washington this week is decisive for auto rules-of-origin and Section 232 tariffs.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Mexico and US bridge differences on autos and steel, and whether Canada rejoins talks.

events.title: Trump-Xi White House summit (Sept 24)
events.why_it_matters: Xi visits the White House Sept 24 with AI, trade, Iran, and Taiwan on the agenda; expectations are low after the underwhelming May Beijing summit but any breakthrough would be market-moving.
events.what_to_watch: Whether any concrete trade, AI chip, or rare-earth deals emerge.

events.title: BRICS 18th Summit (New Delhi)
events.why_it_matters: India hosts the 18th BRICS summit with expansion decisions expected; de-dollarization and energy-pricing coordination could ripple into FX and commodity markets.
events.what_to_watch: Whether BRICS announces new members or any coordinated currency/energy initiatives.

events.title: Apple September 9 event — iPhone 18 Pro & foldable iPhone Ultra
events.why_it_matters: Apple unveils iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max and first foldable iPhone Ultra with 2nm A20 Pro chip; prices expected to rise $200-350, testing consumer resilience.
events.what_to_watch: Pricing, foldable demand signals, and supply-chain read-through for component makers.

events.title: Oracle & Adobe Q3 earnings (same night)
events.why_it_matters: Both report Sept 10 with AI-heavy narratives but divergent models — Oracle shows 27% revenue growth and $638B backlog but -$23.7B FCF; Adobe is a bellwether for software demand.
events.what_to_watch: AI monetization signals and guidance for the software sector.

events.title: Kroger Q2 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Grocery bellwether tests consumer resilience amid food inflation and the July retail-sales decline; revenue est. $34.65B.
events.what_to_watch: Same-store sales and margin guidance for consumer staples.

events.title: Boeing SPEEA engineer contract talks — strike risk
events.why_it_matters: Engineers/technicians rejected Boeing's 'best and final offer' and authorized a strike; talks resumed Sept 8 with contracts expiring Oct 6 — a strike could threaten the 737 MAX 42/month rate.
events.what_to_watch: Whether talks progress or a strike is called before the Oct 6 contract expiry.

events.title: Google ad-tech antitrust ruling — no breakup
events.why_it_matters: Federal judge ruled Google must change ad-tech practices but rejected DOJ's breakup request — third Big Tech antitrust loss that avoids structural remedy.
events.what_to_watch: Whether DOJ appeals and the scope of behavioral remedies.

events.title: US Section 232 drone/UAS tariffs live
events.why_it_matters: 100% duties on larger/thermal UAS and 25% on smaller drones went live Sept 3, aimed at China supply chains with 10-15% allied caps.
events.what_to_watch: Supply-chain disruption and allied exemptions.

events.title: Saudi Arabia halts energy operations after Houthi attacks
events.why_it_matters: Saudi Arabia temporarily halted operations at several energy facilities after Houthi missile/drone attacks sparked fires and wounded 73 people — directly threatening global oil supply.
events.what_to_watch: Duration of the halt and whether Saudi export capacity is materially impaired.

top_risks: US-Iran conflict escalation with oil above $100 and broader Middle East supply disruption
FOMC September hike (57% odds) with hawkish Warsh SEP/dots
USMCA collapse with Canada tariffs escalating and 4th round talks stalling
Saudi energy facility halts threatening global oil supply
Boeing SPEEA strike risk disrupting 737 MAX production
top_opportunities: China exports +25% y/y showing resilient global demand for AI/electronics
Google ad-tech ruling avoiding breakup — positive for Big Tech
Apple foldable iPhone launch driving component supply-chain demand
Oracle/Adobe earnings as AI monetization bellwethers
Trump-Xi summit potential for trade/AI breakthroughs
summary: The September 9, 2026 scan shows an environment dominated by escalating US-Iran conflict with oil near $99 and Saudi energy halts, alongside a hawkish Fed pivot ahead of the September FOMC. Key upcoming catalysts include US CPI/PPI, ECB and BOJ decisions, China inflation data, and the Trump-Xi summit. Trade tensions are intensifying with Canada's retaliatory tariffs and USMCA talks, while earnings from Oracle, Adobe, and Kroger will test AI and consumer narratives. The overall risk environment is elevated with high geopolitical and monetary policy uncertainty.
